evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates creating a game with name/description; other game stories cover inviting, browsing, deleting, etc.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct requirement about inviting via URL; PP-028 only adds a cap on number invited, not the same requirement.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Unique focus on starting a round and entering the item; other item-management stories address list CRUD/selection.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Moderator view of all session items is distinct from participant/estimator views (PP-031) and from selecting/adding/editing/deleting items.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection of an item for estimation is not duplicated elsewhere; PP-013 is about re-estimating earlier items, not the selection UI/ability itself.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD action (add) on item list; edit/delete are separate stories.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD action (edit) on item list; not duplicated by add/delete/import/copy-paste.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD action (delete) on item list; no other story expresses deleting an item.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-033 (show after all have estimated); this is an early reveal capability for moderator.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Unique acceptance rule (average) compared to manual entry (PP-012) or auto-fill on unanimity (PP-011).

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Unique automation condition (unanimous cards) not duplicated by average acceptance or manual entry.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of final estimate is distinct from accepting computed average (PP-010) or auto-fill (PP-011).

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation capability is not duplicated; PP-005 mentions re-estimated in selection context but does not state the requirement to re-estimate earlier items as a feature.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Substantially overlaps with PP-015 (copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet) as both express bringing stories from a spreadsheet into the system; difference in mechanism is not clearly a meaningful business-rule distinction in the requirement set.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates the core requirement of importing stories from a spreadsheet already expressed in PP-014; one is substantially contained in the other as a way to get spreadsheet stories into the game.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from viewing/exporting transcripts (PP-017/18/19) and deleting games (PP-020).

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcript is distinct from exporting transcript formats (PP-018, PP-019).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export to HTML is distinct from export to CSV (PP-019) and from viewing transcript (PP-017).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export to CSV is distinct from export to HTML (PP-018) and from viewing transcript (PP-017).

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game is distinct from deleting an account (PP-024) and deleting an item (PP-008).

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is distinct from login, change details, delete account, and password reminder.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is distinct from account creation (PP-021) and password reminder (PP-026).

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Updating account details is distinct from creating/deleting account and password reminder.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an account is distinct from deleting a game (PP-020) and other account operations.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story covers timezone localization.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is distinct from login and account management.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Unique configuration of card/scale set; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Adds a specific business rule (limit 15) not stated in PP-002; not a duplicate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining as estimator is distinct from moderator inviting via URL (PP-002).

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from seeing all items (PP-031) and from moderator item selection (PP-005).

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Estimator view of all items is distinct from moderator view (PP-004) by actor/role; allowed as separate per criterion guidance.

evaluations.evidence: see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Unique requirement about showing submission status per estimator; not duplicated by showing actual estimates (PP-033/036).

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-009 (show immediately before all estimates) due to different trigger/business rule.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-041, which expresses the same ability to change an estimate until the draw is completed; no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique requirement about historical per-estimator estimates for the current story; not duplicated by PP-039 (scroll back through prior rounds generally).

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-033 (reveal timing) and PP-032 (who has submitted) because it concerns mapping estimator to estimate values in the round.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Starting a shared timer is distinct from auto-reset behavior (PP-038).

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-reset rule is distinct from the ability to start the timer (PP-037).

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Unique navigation/history browsing during a game; not duplicated by transcript viewing/exporting (post-game) stories.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Unique UI consistency requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-034 (change estimate until reveal/draw completion) with no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Unique personalization/UI requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Distinct non-functional requirement from accessibility (PP-047) and browser compatibility (PP-046).

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Unique documentation/glossary requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Unique performance-related implementation requirement; not duplicated by general responsiveness (PP-048).

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Unique browser compatibility requirement; not duplicated by standards compliance or accessibility.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Unique accessibility requirement; distinct from XHTML/CSS standards and browser compatibility.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: General responsiveness NFR is not duplicated; PP-045 is a specific technical means, not the same requirement statement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unique internationalization/character support requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Unique URL design requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Unique error-handling UX requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Unique privacy/anonymization requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Unique analytics/metrics requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.
